description: Gan Ning, wild chinese river raider in the supplied pixel art style. Thick swept-back black hair with a red headband and long tails, a bare tanned chest with a red scarf, a red sash hung with gold bells, black trousers with gold-trimmed boots. He holds a curved sickle raised in the right hand with a long iron chain hanging from it
face: A cocky grinning face, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the swept-back black hair with the red headband tails, the bare back with the red scarf, the red sash, the chain hanging at his side, the sickle raised at his right.
guard_action: the right hand brings the sickle to a ready position in front, the body drops into a low agile stance

actions.idle: Low agile guard with a chain sickle in the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless fast combat run in place carrying the chain sickle, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b1: Thrust, then hooking up. Frames 1-5 draw back; frame 6 a short straight jab; frames 7-8 the sickle drops low; frame 9 it hooks upward; frames 10-11 finish high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The chain sickle stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Deep downward hook. Frames 1-6 the sickle is raised over the shoulder; frame 8 he drops low and chops it down; frames 9-11 hold low. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The chain sickle stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Spinning hook. Frames 1-3 wind to the right; frames 4-7 one full turn on a low hop; frame 9 a step and the sickle hooks in; frames 10-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The chain sickle stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s1: Raider strike. Frames 1-6 he crouches low with the sickle hidden behind; frame 8 he springs in and hooks short and hard; frames 9-12 hold close. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The chain sickle stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b1 → a3 → b3, 전법 s1. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
